executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $146.0 per resident day (40.3% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $3,591,670 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 14,125 Medicaid days, $254.28 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $251.88 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $251.56 for July 2025 to June 2026.

Cost year 2025: DSS's review removed $112,611 of the $250,183 management fee (page 16, line m12), leaving $137,572 in the costs DSS counts. The data shows the change, not the reason; DSS caps management fees and can remove related-party charges.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was -13.1% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $224,732, 8.0% of the $2,804,637 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $502,326, $26.15 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $299,130 (59.5%), allocated fringe $44,568 (8.9%), non-wage costs $158,628 (31.6%). Raw food was $140,028 ($7.29 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $4,764.

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 10 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $185,543 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Administrative Management Services (page 16 line m12), removed $112,611; Management Fee Services Direct (page 20 line 5j), removed $17,046; Prescription Drugs Purchased From Other (page 20 line 5a2), removed $15,255. Separately, the home itself removed $570,727 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

limitations: Dollar figures are as filed, before DSS audit, and are not adjusted for inflation. Compare per-resident-day figures with the Connecticut median for the same year.
Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075388/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
